text: The Patriots' Week 4 victory over the Bills at Highmark Stadium was equal parts redemption and statement-making, as Drake Maye shook off his early-season struggles with a clutch performance that resulted in three touchdown passes and a game-winning drive—all despite two turnovers—to deliver Buffalo its first defeat in their new stadium and give coach Mike Vrabel what he emphasized as a critical win for the defending AFC East champions. The result has everyone asking whether New England's 0-3 start was indeed an overreaction worth panicking about, particularly with defensive reinforcements like Dre'Mont Jones, Craig Woodson, and Eli Raridon returning to full availability for the divisional matchup. While receiver Romeo Doubs continues searching for his footing after signing a four-year deal in March, the offensive performance against Josh Allen's defense suggests the Patriots' trajectory may be far more encouraging than those first three weeks indicated.
